topIssues.title: flake: TestUnsafeGapFillAfterSafeReorg
topIssues.author: ajsutton
topIssues.body:
**Claude:** Reporting flaky test.

## Flaky Test Report

**Test:** `TestUnsafeGapFillAfterSafeReorg`
**Package:** `github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/op-acceptance-tests/tests/sync/elsync/reorg`
**Job:** `memory-all-opn-op-geth`

## Failure Details

**Error:**
```
Error Trace: /home/circleci/project/op-acceptance-tests/tests/sync/elsync/reorg/sync_test.go:84
Error: "2" is not greater than or equal to "3"
Test: TestUnsafeGapFillAfterSafeReorg
```

**Duration:** 61.29s

## CI Link

https://app.circleci.com/pipelines/github/ethereum-optimism/optimism/121550/workflows/552d84df-4c8f-4d24-a572-260daa8baa8e/jobs/4725058/tests

## Context

The test asserts that some count (likely unsafe blocks) is >= 3, but only 2 were observed. This suggests a timing-dependent condition where the system hasn't produced enough blocks by the time the assertion fires.
